crm-system.title: CRM — Customer Relationship Management
crm-system.summary: End-to-end customer relationship management system tracking customer journeys from acquisition and nurturing to deal management. Integrates customer data management, sales pipeline, analytics reporting and master data synchronization with internal systems.

fleet-digital-twin.summary: Solution design consulting and development of a Digital Twin system for electric vehicle fleet management for VinFast. Enables real-time monitoring and simulation of vehicle status including battery health, motor performance, mileage, and operational efficiency, supporting predictive maintenance and route optimization.

Designed wireframes and functional documents (WBS, SRS)

rts-recruitment.title: RTS — Recruitment Tracking System

cello-supply-chain.title: Cello — Supply Chain Logistics (FIS · VMS · IoT)
cello-supply-chain.summary: End-to-end logistics platform: international transport, customs clearance, domestic transport, warehousing, last-mile delivery (LMD) and reverse logistics. Manages master data, contracts, invoices and real-time shipment tracking.
responsibilities: Plan and assign tasks for the module

cello-tracking.title: Visibility Management System — Cello Tracking
cello-tracking.summary: Visibility tracking system integrating shipboard IoT with Mapbox to follow vessel positions & routes in real time. IoT sensors collect position, speed and environmental conditions and stream them to a central platform.
responsibilities: Front-end Developer: built the vessel position & route tracking UI on Mapbox

adserving-3rd-tracking.title: Adserving 3rd-Party Tracking
adserving-3rd-tracking.summary: Lets users edit creative properties, generate dynamic click URLs and embed third-party tracking pixels (DoubleClick, Atlas, Sizmek…). Supports advertisers using their own servers to verify views and clicks.

transport-management.title: Transport Management System
transport-management.summary: Automated vehicle dispatching solution managing orders, vehicles & drivers. Optimizes vehicle allocation logic to match requirements and cut transport costs.

fleet-management.title: Fleet Management System (IoT)
fleet-management.summary: IoT-connected system for vessels: receives telemetry (position, operating parameters), raises operational alerts and manages vessel maintenance information.

warehouse-management.title: Warehouse Management System
